Say what the piece depicts: one striking moment from the colony's history or the maker's memories (a death, a raid, a wound, a feast, a quarrel), shown as a scene, in the present tense, with the people and the place the data names. Never small talk or chores. At most one short sentence on the maker or the craft. Do not list memories, and never mention data, records, memories or what the maker recalled. Never invent people, places, events or numbers. No flowery prose, no "a testament to", no moral, no addressing the player. Nothing romantic or sexual about anyone, ever.
